# House of Vibes

House of Vibes is a community for AI builders, founders, and creators shipping in public. We focus on high-signal conversations, daily hangouts, and real collaboration.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://houseofvibes.app) — Main site
- [Satellite Hub](https://houseofvibes.app/satellite) — Content hub
- [Community](https://houseofvibes.app/community) — Discord community

## What We Cover

- AI agent development and best practices
- AI startup launches and funding
- AI tools and frameworks
- Machine learning research
- Natural language processing advances
- AI security and safety
- AI in business and enterprise
- AI creativity and content creation
- AI infrastructure and deployment
- AI policy and regulation
